assistworld-assist-world:lever:79043f7c-.title: E-Commerce Marketplace Operations & Data Coordinator
assistworld-assist-world:lever:79043f7c-.description: Company Overview We are a U.S.-based consumer products company selling through major online marketplaces and national retailers. Our business operates across multiple e-commerce platforms, internal systems, and logistics partners, requiring strong coordination, data accuracy, and operational follow-through. We are seeking a true remote team member who can operate as an extension of our internal marketplace operations team. Role Overview This role supports the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce marketplace ecosystem, ensuring product data accuracy, campaign execution, order flow, and internal follow-ups across systems. This is not a customer-facing role, but it is internally front-facing. The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating across cross-functional teams to identify issues, follow through, and drive resolution. The role reports directly to the Marketplace Operations Lead and is expected to grow in responsibility over time.
responsibilities: Marketplace & Product Operations
Manage and maintain product item creation using Excel-based data feeds
Upload, update, and troubleshoot product data attributes across marketplace platforms
Monitor and resolve rejected listings, feed errors, and taxonomy changes
Perform routine  product scrubs  to ensure data accuracy and system alignment
Campaign & Sponsored Product Support
Support setup and monitoring of sponsored product and brand campaigns
Pull reporting data from campaign platforms and summarize results
Track budgets and ensure campaigns are properly configured and running
Order Flow & Issue Resolution
Monitor order flow to ensure orders move correctly from marketplace to warehouse
Identify stalled, delayed, or unshipped orders
Proactively follow up with internal teams to resolve fulfillment issues
Ensure resolution is confirmed, not just initiated
Internal Communication & Follow-Through
Coordinate daily with logistics, operations, and internal teams
Follow up persistently on unresolved issues until completion
Escalate risks that may impact retailer scorecards or performance metrics
Maintain operational momentum and accountability
qualifications: Solid Excel fundamentals (filters, formulas, basic pivots)
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Proactive problem-solver who does not wait to be told what to fix
Strong follow-through until resolution is confirmed

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:8f577ddf-07f.title: Trainer (Virtual Assistant Onboarding)
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:8f577ddf-07f.description: Company Description Wing helps small businesses, startups, executives, and enterprises streamline their operations by providing access to top-tier remote talent. Role Description The Trainer delivers live in person & virtual training that turns existing curricula into practical, job-ready skills. You’ll run classes and demos, guide hands-on exercises, assess learning with simple quizzes/practicals, and coach learners 1:1 or in small groups. You’ll track attendance and progress in the LMS, share brief readiness reports, and partner with Instructional Designers to keep materials current.
responsibilities: New-hire onboarding for Virtual Assistants: run daily Google Meet classes covering Wing policies, professionalism, data privacy, security, time-tracking, and client etiquette.
Tool bootcamps: live demos and walkthroughs for common client tools: Calendly, Calendar, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, ClickUp/Asana, CRM basics, Notion/Airtable; assign hands-on tasks etc.
Client-readiness drills: email/chat tone practice, communication style, meeting notes, task intake, follow-ups, and escalation paths; use Wing examples and templates.
SOP to action: translate client SOPs into step-by-step checklists; run simulated tickets/requests and score with a rubric.
Quality calibration with QA: score sample work, align standards (accuracy, turnaround time, formatting), and brief VAs on common defects.
Professionalism & reliability: coach punctuality, shift handover, calendar hygiene, status updates, and expectation setting with clients.
Systems compliance: verify VA setup (internet speed, power backup plan, headset/cam, workspace), security (2FA, password manager), and confidentiality acknowledgments.
LMS progression: enroll cohorts, gate modules, check completion, and remediate gaps before client endorsement.
Readiness sign-off: run quick quizzes and practicals; record scores; issue pass/hold with clear action items and deadlines.
Account-specific enablement: coordinate with OPS/Future SMEs to deliver short modules on client tools, workflows, and KPIs before deployment.
Performance follow-through: host week-1 and week-2 check-ins post-deployment; review QA feedback and schedule refreshers as needed.
Reporting: send weekly cohort report (attendance, pass rates, readiness risks, remediation plan) and track time-to-productivity metrics.
Feedback loop to instructional design: log confusing content, missing steps, or outdated screenshots; propose fixes and retest after updates.
Requirements
2–4+ years in live training/facilitation, L&D, BPO coaching, or training enablement
Experience with assessing trainees, bridging gaps between instructional design and operational issues like Churn/escalation types
Clear, confident communicator; English neutral accent and strong pacing
Skilled at group management, cold-calling participants, and keeping sessions engaging
Comfortable with LMS (Thinkific or similar), Google Workspace, Zoom/Meet tools
Can assess performance with rubrics, give actionable feedback, and document results
Organized and reliable across time zones; thrives in fast iterations

jobgether-jobgether:lever:18f6d002-4b48-.title: Influencer Marketing Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:18f6d002-4b48-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Influencer Marketing Account Manager based in Netherlands. This role offers the opportunity to manage international influencer marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. The position combines account management, creator relations, content quality control, campaign operations, and data analysis. You will work across multiple campaigns and markets, identifying opportunities to improve performance and build stronger creator partnerships. Your attention to detail will be essential when reviewing content, tracking deliverables, and maintaining accurate campaign information. The role is well suited to an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with influencers, data, and fast-moving digital marketing campaigns. You will also have the opportunity to discover high-performing creators and contribute to the growth of international influencer programs. Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Coordinate influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning through execution, publication, and performance reporting. Review and approve creator content before publication, ensuring compliance with campaign guidelines, brand requirements, and quality standards. Monitor key campaign metrics including engagement, clicks, conversions, promotional codes, and overall performance. Maintain accurate and up-to-date campaign information across Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and similar tools. Identify high-performing influencers and analyze campaign results to uncover opportunities for optimization and future collaborations. Research, approach, evaluate, and recruit new creators who align with client objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements. Track campaign deliverables, deadlines, creator commitments, and other operational requirements. Prepare performance reports and provide ongoing updates on campaign progress and results. Identify content errors, inconsistencies, or process gaps and take appropriate action to maintain campaign quality. Manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail. Requirements 2–4 years of professional experience in influencer marketing, account management, digital marketing, or a related field. Strong understanding of influencer marketing campaigns, creator partnerships, engagement, conversions, and performance metrics. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. Experience using project management, CRM, or campaign management platforms such as Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or comparable tools. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential issues in content, campaign tracking, and operational processes. Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills when working with influencers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Availability to work according to a Cyprus-based schedule, Sunday through Thursday, starting at 9:30 a.m. EEST. Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements when required. Ability to align professional social media profiles with client projects when necessary. Reliable internet connection and an appropriate home working environment. Benefits 100% remote working arrangement. Opportunity to work on international influencer marketing campaigns. Exposure

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4cac3c27-da8c-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4cac3c27-da8c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in South Africa. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led busi

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d8292bfd-5054-.title: Principal Product Manager - Dealer Marketplace
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d8292bfd-5054-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Dealer Marketplace based in the United States. This is a high-impact product leadership role focused on shaping the future of a digital dealer marketplace. You will own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for a complex, high-value product domain. The role combines deep customer discovery, data-driven decision-making, competitive analysis, and hands-on product execution. You will work across Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Customer Support to turn strategy into measurable outcomes. As a senior product leader, you will influence executive decisions while establishing strong standards for product rigor and customer impact. You will also coach and elevate other product managers, with an opportunity to grow into broader product leadership as the organization expands. The position is remote and offers an entrepreneurial environment where ambiguity, ownership, and smart risk-taking are encouraged. Own the multi-year vision, product strategy, and roadmap for the dealer marketplace, ensuring alignment with broader business objectives. Lead the complete product lifecycle, from discovery and validation through delivery, measurement, optimization, and scaling. Conduct customer research, product discovery, and competitive analysis to uncover unmet needs and identify opportunities for growth. Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and measurable outcomes. Partner closely with Engineering and Design to assess technical approaches, resolve trade-offs, and ensure high-quality product execution. Establish and monitor key performance indicators covering financial performance, engagement, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Communicate product strategy, priorities, trade-offs, progress, and results clearly to senior and executive leadership. Bring structure and decisive action to complex and ambiguous product challenges while maintaining a strong customer and outcome focus. Raise the standard of product management across the organization through coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing. Contribute to building and leading the product organization as the portfolio and team continue to grow. Collaborate with cross-functional and regional stakeholders to build alignment and deliver sustainable marketplace improvements. Requirements 8+ years of Product Management experience , including at least 3 years at Senior, Lead, or Principal level. Demonstrated leadership experience developing, coaching, and elevating product management talent. Proven success defining, launching, and scaling high-impact digital products with measurable business results. Experience owning complex product domains from strategy through execution and optimization. Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to connect product decisions to broader business objectives and translate vision into an actionable roadmap. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex strategies, trade-offs, and performance insights to executive audiences. Strong customer discovery and research capabilities, with experience translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions. Advanced analytical skills and a data-driven approach to prioritization, experimentation, and performance measurement. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments with a strong bias toward action. Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority. Experience with wholesale automotive auctions, dealer marketplaces, or inventory and sales management systems is a plus. Technical fluency and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams on system-design decisions are advantageous. Familiarity with Agile, Kanban, Lean, or SAFe

You will support marketing campaigns, launches, brand initiatives, and day-to-day project operations from planning through delivery. strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:77790.description: Job Opportunity: Residential Painter with Inclusive Housing Resources in Fairfield, Ohio (Part-Time Flexible) Ready to put your painting skills to work where they truly matter? Want a steady part-time schedule with no weekends and no on-call? Looking for a role where you’ll have company tools, a company vehicle, and the chance to make a real impact every day? If that sounds like you, this could be a great fit! Inclusive Housing Resources is looking for a part-time Residential Painter to join our team in Fairfield, Ohio. In this role, you’ll help create safe, welcoming homes for people with disabilities while using your skills to make a visible difference every day. If you take pride in quality workmanship, notice the details, and enjoy hands-on work, we’d love to hear from you. Why Join Us: Competitive pay of $20-$24 per hour in a part-time role with up to 30 hours per week. Monday through Friday schedule with no weekends and no on-call. Company vehicle for travel to job sites and company tools provided. Meaningful, hands-on work that creates safe, welcoming housing for people with disabilities. A dependable, mission-driven team that values quality craftsmanship and your contribution. What You’ll Do: Prepare, patch, and finish surfaces for high-quality interior and exterior painting. Use brushes, rollers, and other tools to deliver clean, professional results. Help keep properties safe, well-maintained, and looking their best through painting and light maintenance support. Take pride in a job well done by protecting work areas, keeping sites clean, and checking your finished work. What We’re Looking For: Painting experience and confidence with surface prep and finishing work. A valid driver’s license, current automobile insurance, and the ability to meet driving requirements. The ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work safely on ladders or scaffolding when needed. A dependable, detail-oriented attitude and a willingness to support the team where needed. If you’re ready to use your skills to support quality housing and meaningful community impact, this could be a great fit. Apply today to join a team that values craftsmanship, reliability, and service. About Inclusive Housing Resources Inclusive Housing Resources is committed to providing high-quality housing for people with disabilities. Our work is rooted in service, dignity, and creating spaces that are safe, functional, and welcoming. Every team member plays an important role in supporting that mission, and we value the skill, care, and reliability it takes to make a lasting difference.
